changes_made.explanation: Consolidated duplicate dataset names and normalized to standard forms. Removed tree-structured LSTM models that were only mentioned in related work but not used in this paper. Consolidated model descriptions to the most complete and accurate version. Consolidated output descriptions.

No LLMs were used as judges in this 2020 paper

overall_notes: The paper focuses on surface realization using synthetic data. The extraction was generally good but contained some duplicates and included models that were only mentioned in related work. The paper uses only BLEU for evaluation and references previous shared task human evaluations but does not conduct its own human evaluation.
